Episode 247: Liberation War of Lafrarosa (5)

Although Jin had merely walked for a moment in his inner world and met Lingling before returning, five hours had already passed outside. For those five hours, Murakan and the battle kings had been protecting the slowly moving Jin, who resembled a sleepwalking patient, and continued their battle.
“Whew…!”
When Jin took a deep breath, everyone on the battlefield seemed to freeze in time momentarily.
Despite the roaring clashes of Qi and thunderous energies, everyone picked up on Jin's breathing.
“Brother Jin!”
“Are you back to your senses?”
The first faces he saw were Garmund and Beliz
They had just been fending off enemy attacks that had been targeting Jin.

Both of them were covered in wounds, both minor and major. Considering Jin's sudden disappearance and the five-hour-long battle they had endured, it was fortunate that they were in their current state.
From a distance, Teto, assisting Murakan, looked as if he might collapse any moment. Linpa coughed up blood with every strained breath.
Murakan had sustained the most injuries. He was the main target of the Red Plutonian's attacks, so even someone as powerful as him wasn't safe.
Protecting one person during a fight is several times harder. It was only because of Murakan and the battle kings that no one had died or been critically injured so far.
[Oh man, kid, are you finally up!? You said you’d be gone for a moment, but you’ve been gone for five hours.]
“You were unconscious for five hours!”
“...Five hours!? Was it that long?”

Jin's eyes widened. It was the most shocking moment of the battle for him. He had experienced the difference in the passage of time between his inner world and reality before, but this was during a battle.
“But you don’t have to feel sorry. You went to save Lingling!”
“How’s the liberation device?”
“Of course, we haven’t used it yet. How is Lingling?”
Even as Garmund asked, he had a good hunch. He had just noticed that the chaotic energy consuming Jin's heart had disappeared.
The dark energy wasn't completely gone. At the very center of his heart, there was a point of energy that shimmered like a black pearl. It was Lingling’s energy.
When Jin silently called out to Lingling, Garmund could instantly hear the voice.
[I'm fine! Garmund. He appeared just in time to save me.]
"Oh, Lingling! So, did Lingling escape from Lafrarosa too? Wait, if that's the case, wouldn't the time in Lafrarosa stop again?"

[Explaining in detail is complicated, so I'll put it simply. My body is still inside Lafrarosa. Only my consciousness has transferred to Jin. Therefore, time in Lafrarosa remains unchanged, and Vahn... she will appear soon.]
Upon hearing Lingling's words, the ones most shocked were not Jin, Murakan, or the Kings.
Shimat. He was keenly observing Jin, who had regained his senses, trying to understand if Jin had truly succeeded in his gamble.
"Fire!"
Shimat's angry voice resonated across the battlefield. The aerial fortresses and fleet's attacks that had been targeting the surroundings now concentrated on Jin.
At that moment, Jin understood what Lingling had just said.
'Jin, you did well saving Lingling.'
A familiar voice echoed inside Jin's head.
'Thanks to you, I feel much better. Once again, I can observe the outside world through your physical form.'
It was Vahn's voice. Lingling had started their fusion.
Ordinarily, this fusion required Jin and Vahn, and Lingling to be within a certain distance or have a frequency tracking synchronization device developed by Qwaul.
But not now. With Lingling's consciousness transferred from Vahn to Jin's inner world, all those conditions vanished.
Clearly, this was all thanks to the chaos that Shimat had unleashed. The chaos spread by the witch in the desert was now erasing the boundaries between the three of them.
'Sister Vahn!'
Jin's radiant heart, which glowed like golden lightning, was turning blue. His eyes filled with a deep blue energy, and Sigmund seemed to be forged with thunder, roaring fiercely.
The energy emanating from Jin distorted the space around him. Through that distorted space, Shimat's Red Divine Swords and Red Energy Artillery were falling.
Jin did not dodge but swung his sword in response.
A horizontal slash without any preparatory motion, but within it was the essence of martial arts that Vahn and Jin had accumulated over time.
As the blade cut through the air, the attacks that came into contact with the blade dispersed as if glass was shattering.
Given the immense concentration of energy, it was not completely neutralized by that alone.
However, the attack could not hit Jin as intended. Like a chariot tripped by a rock, it quickly tilted to the side and crashed into the ground.

All the trajectories of the attacks were being twisted in such a way. As the sword energy gushed from the sword and struck it down, thousands of bolts of flat lightning accompanying it tore through the remaining attacks.
"What is this...!"
The Red Plutonian could only be astounded.

To be precise, most of the Red Plutonian members weren't even aware of what had transpired. Only Shimat, the battle kings, and some first-class battle kings could precisely grasp the situation. The fact that Jin had neutralized all these attacks with just a single strike.
‘And now, I can finally see the faces of those lowly creatures who have been tormenting me and my brothers. So... is that one the king of those lowly ones?’
Jin's gaze landed on Shimat, who wore an unprecedentedly stunned expression.
He could sense it. Even if Vahn hadn't completely emerged from Lafrarosa, she was manifesting through Jin's physical body.
The projectiles repelled by the flat lightning rained onto the protective shields of the airborne fortresses and fleets. Vahn noticed that Shimat wasn't protecting his regular fleets at all.
‘He's strong. But for one with a radiant heart, his heart seems too cold. Well... that must be why he challenged me fearlessly.’
While Vahn spoke, Jin sensed her dilemma. Should she increase the sync rate and engage in combat directly or should she leave it to Jin while maintaining the current fusion level?
‘Vahn, how do you want to proceed?’
‘I'd like to punish them directly, but right now, it's better if Jin brother uses the sword. I'm quite injured from Lingling's rampage just now.’
Moreover, the attacks of the Red Plutonian, dimensional errors, and the original chaos were still ravaging Lafrarosa. Taking the fusion to the fullest level could cause problems in Lafrarosa.
‘I understand.’
‘Moreover, brother is now Genesis, right? I've lent you a bit of power, which will be more efficient than before. After the fight is over and we go out, We must celebrate properly.’
‘I'm looking forward to it. And Vahn, we will soon throw an ancient millennium iron box into Lafrarosa. Please catch it well. It's the device to liberate Lafrarosa.’

‘Ah, so that's what it was. I was already cautious because Tantel brother brought a piece of ancient millennium iron. If it's not lost due to dimensional errors, I should be able to catch it. Then for now... I'll leave it to you to punish them.’
With those words, Vahn fell silent.
It was to focus on Lafrarosa. However, their fusion wasn't severed, so Jin could still share the senses she gained as a Battle God.
As Vahn said, that was enough. As Jin had also reached Genesis, he could understand Vahn's senses much more vividly than before.
"...Indeed, the sky above the sky. I can't think of Vahn sister any other way."
It was magical.
As he prepared to swing his sword, every single cell in his body seemed to move solely for that purpose.
Even though it was just a simple vertical or horizontal slash, a new realm, previously unfelt, was being revealed to Jin.
It was as if a blurry veil, unnoticed for a lifetime, had been covering his eyes, preventing him from seeing properly until now.

He could spot numerous vulnerabilities in the enemies positioned in the sky. Despite the fact that the Red plutonian had not suffered significant damage since Jin's departure and had maintained a more solid formation, Jin could still see these openings.
'This sensation, it's the wall between me and Sister Vahn.'
As Jin tried to thrust his sword into those gaps, Shimat instinctively put more distance between them.
"Retreat!"
His voice wasn't faster than the sword. The moment Shimat began to open his mouth, a sword's aura, thundering like lightning, was pounding on the linked shield of the aerial fortress.
Wooz-jik-!
A sound reminiscent of a breaking wooden pillar resonated. By just hearing it, it seemed like a minor shock was transmitted to the shield.
But the next moment, Jin's sword energy tore the shield apart and slammed down onto the center of the Pibil that was placed in its core.
It was precisely where the power source was. Thanks to Bakarun, who hastily moved upon Shimat's command — albeit a beat slower than Jin's sword — the direct hit to the power source was avoided.
'What...! The central armor was torn like this?'
Not just the Red Plutonian, but even the Battle Kings were in shock with their mouths agape. The center of each aerial fortress had always been the spot they most desired to attack during battles.
Not only did he accurately target that spot, but he also tore its armor as if it was paper.

In reality, the Battle Kings, with the help of Murakan, had hit the central armor of the aerial fortress several times before. Every time, they were repelled by the Red waves energy surrounding the armor, preventing them from dealing proper damage.
[I told you, little brothers. You can't just try to break them with strength alone. Like that, just like that.]
"What do you mean by 'like that'!?"
"Tsk, mere mortals like us wouldn't understand the mysteries of the Genesis."
Murakan and the Battle Kings laughed at each other. Their faces, which had been tense from fighting off enemies to protect Jin, were now uncharacteristically bright.
However, when Jin amplified the aura of his heart's core and aimed Sigmund at the Red Plutonian, the Battle Kings immediately lost their smiles.
[Are you prepared to face the wrath of the Plutonian, Shimat?]
Shimat didn't respond but gripped Tetallon tightly.
